findings.title: Portfolio is well-aligned with growth model target
findings.detail: The portfolio is currently well-aligned with the growth model target. All asset classes are within the {{m:cfg.drift_tolerance.pp}} percentage point tolerance, with no significant drift observed across the portfolio. No rebalancing is required at this time.

findings.title: Unused RRSP contribution room available
findings.detail: The client has {{m:tax.rrsp_room.cad}} of unused RRSP contribution room. Contributing to an RRSP can provide tax-deferred growth and potential tax deductions, which may align with long-term growth objectives. This is an educational observation regarding available contribution space.

The portfolio's current volatility of {{m:risk.vol.pct}} is well within the maximum suitability band of {{m:risk.vol_band_max.pct}} for a growth-oriented investor with a long time horizon. The portfolio aligns closely with the model volatility of {{m:risk.target_vol.pct}}.
findings.title: Portfolio volatility is within suitability limits

findings.detail: In an equity bear market scenario, the portfolio is projected to lose {{m:stress.equity_bear.cad}}, representing a decline of {{m:stress.equity_bear.pct}}. Given the client's long time horizon of thirty years, this downside is acceptable for a growth strategy.
findings.title: Stress test results indicate manageable downside risk

findings.detail: The portfolio maintains no single-security concentration exceeding the limit of {{m:conc.limit.pct}}, ensuring appropriate diversification across asset classes.
findings.title: No single-security concentration issues identified

findings.detail: US equity markets experienced significant growth, with the index returning {{m:mkt.us_equity_ytd.pct}} percent year to date, driven by a rally in technology stocks. This performance likely increased the relative weight of US equities within the portfolio.
findings.title: US Equity Growth Drives Portfolio Drift
Canadian Equity and Energy Sector Volatility
findings.detail: Canadian equity performance was more moderate at {{m:mkt.ca_equity_ytd.pct}} percent year to date. Additionally, the energy sector faced volatility, declining {{m:mkt.energy_sector_qtd.pct}} percent quarter to date, which likely impacted the Canadian equity allocation.

Canadian bond yields have trended lower, with the ten-year yield currently at {{m:mkt.ca_10y_yield.pct}} percent. The bond index returned {{m:mkt.ca_bond_ytd.pct}} percent year to date, reflecting a cooling inflation environment that influenced fixed income valuations.
findings.title: Canadian Bond Market Yield Compression
International Equity and Real Assets Performance
findings.detail: International equities contributed to portfolio movement with a year to date return of {{m:mkt.intl_equity_ytd.pct}} percent, while real assets, represented by REITs, saw a year to date return of {{m:mkt.reit_ytd.pct}} percent. These returns contributed to the overall drift in the non-domestic and alternative portions of the portfolio.
